sentence: This project tries to find out which energy sources brain tumors use to grow in patients, using molecular imaging.
This project builds matched induced pluripotent stem cells and organoids from humans and chimpanzees to compare how their genomes work.
This project gets an ultrasound imaging system to image the experimental models used to study cardiovascular disease.
This project studies how RNA transcripts help human cells repair broken DNA ends.
This project tries to engineer scalable sources of hematopoietic stem cells using knowledge about mitochondrial remodeling in the embryo.
This project maps lipids, RNA transcripts and protein markers in the type 1 diabetic pancreas using several imaging methods.
This project designs compounds that work against both wild-type and drug-resistant strains of HIV.
This project builds computational methods that combine brain imaging and multi-omics data to find subtypes of Alzheimer's disease and forecast its progression.
This project studies how patterns of activity across the hippocampus, prefrontal cortex and motor output pathways support flexible behavior.
This project tests whether imaging with a radionuclide can show vein inflammation caused by chemotherapy in young cancer patients.
This project provides data science and omics analysis, including study design and statistical analysis, to support cancer research.
This project studies how vagal sensory neurons in the heart detect signals in blood and activate brain circuits that control cardiovascular reflexes.
This project studies how mechanical regulation of intestine stem cells keeps gut tissue balanced in Drosophila.
This project tests whether inhibiting nicotinamide N-methyltransferase in the liver protects against alcohol-induced fatty liver, using cell culture and animal models.
This project runs a shared core that offers tissue culture and molecular biology techniques to vision scientists.
This project studies how a partial tandem duplication drives acute myeloid leukemia, using genomic and proteomic approaches.
This project tests genome editing as a treatment for Gould syndrome, a disorder caused by mutations in type IV collagen.
This project builds a CRISPR-based paper strip test that detects Mycobacterium tuberculosis DNA in blood.
This project studies the structure and function of henipavirus surface glycoproteins and finds sites that protective antibodies target.
This project tests fluorescence imaging to find necrotic tissue in burn patients before and during surgery.
